messages.subject: plot.pxg: error message
parts:
Hi all,
I'm working with an introgression library looking for QTL for disease resistance. This collection of NIL has been genotyped using SNP. Some SNP has two genotypic classes, others three. When the SNP with two genotypic classes is plotted using the plot.pxg function the following error message is obtained:
Error in axis(side = 1, at = 1:length(observed), labels = tmp, cex = ifelse(n.mark == :
  'at' and 'labels' lengths differ, 2 != 3
Why I get this message? How can I solve this?
I really appreciate any help you can provide.
Cheers.

Maxi Dallo

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] plot.pxg: error message
parts:
This is a bug; if one of the possible genotypes is not observed, plot.pxg gives an error.
I don't have an immediate fix.

karl
